answer: Our decentralized protocol leverages a stake-slashing matrix, akin to a basalt rock formation, to resist Sybil attacks. Agents verify each other's identities via a cryptographic river of reputation commitments, while a verifiable delay attestation ensures that each commitment is made at a distinct time. As a ripple effect, malicious agents incur a prohibitively high capital lockup, rendering Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
